watchOut: The 1% figure is from a 2021 article (modified 2025), not a rate page.
name: Saint John Capital
summary: Factoring for small fleets with a full advance and no reserve, plus an online instant quote.
differentiator: Advances 100% of the invoice on delivery with no reserve held back, so nothing waits on the broker paying. Its only published rate, "as little as 1%", comes from an article, not a rate page, so treat it as a floor.

terms.rate: We factor your trucking invoices for as little as 1% (article)
terms.advance: 100% cash advance upon delivery, or 50% fuel advance at pick-up
terms.speed: Same-day payment when the BOL is uploaded by 12:00 EST
terms.fuel: Fuel discounts at over 1,500 truck stops

bestFor: Small fleets that want the whole invoice up front.
skipIf: You want a rate schedule; the quote comes through a form.
